title: Mara Vale complex biography authoring
description: A source-rich living-person benchmark requiring disciplined biography, primary-versus-independent attribution, correction handling, work chronology, critical reception, and complete exclusion of unsupported personal rumors.

article.title: Mara Vale
article.article_object: A substantial encyclopedia biography of a fictional living software artist, centered on documented practice, selected works, exhibitions, award, and attributed critical reception.
article.reader_need: Understand Vale's artistic practice and development while clearly distinguishing artist statements, institutional facts, and critical interpretations and excluding unsupported personal material.
